<subject>Draft of Network Upgrade Transition Memo to David Larsen</subject>
<body>
David,  

As we just discussed, this is the transition memo suggesting that you place a call to Stephen Mclaughlin.  

As noted in the memo, we are still working through with the legal team what leave status our Network Engineering staff would need to take while supporting both the private upgrade project and the publicly funded infrastructure expansion. The answer to this may affect their willingness to participate, in some cases.
</body>
<quoted>
</quoted>
